Excited to announce the Sakana AI Security Research Group, an independent, public-interest R&D team in Tokyo co-led by Akihiro Umegai and me.

Cybersecurity has become a critical national priority for Japan as AI changes the speed and economics of both offense and defense. Rather than endlessly chasing patches downstream, we are approaching security as an upstream quality engineering problem, something Japan has long been strong at. We are also researching collective multi-agent defense and how to secure AI agents themselves.

We will be publishing our research, reproducible benchmarks, and practical playbooks openly, while working closely with partners across government, industry, and academia.

Full English post here: sakana.ai/security-research-…

We're hiring researchers in Tokyo to help shape the group's agenda across systems reliability and AI agent security: sakana.ai/careers/member-of-…

Sakana AI、AIセキュリティ専門の研究開発チーム「Security Research Group」始動 🐙

ブログ：sakana.ai/security-research-…
Careers：sakana.ai/careers/member-of-…

AIを活用した集合的なサイバー防御と、AIシステム自体の安全性とセキュリティの確保を研究する研究開発チーム「Security Research Group」を 立ち上げました。

AIによってソフトウェアの欠陥が見つかりインシデントが増加している中、セキュリティを品質の問題として捉え、設計や開発の段階から欠陥を作り込まないことを目的とした本質的なセキュリティの向上等の調査・研究開発に取り組みます。品質の作り込みは、日本が長く強みとしてきた分野でもあります。

本グループは事業活動とは切り離して運営し、研究成果や再現可能なベンチマーク、実践的なガイドラインを公開しながら、政府、産業界、学術界と連携していきます。

⎯⎯⎯

Introducing the Sakana AI Security Research Group 🐡

Blog: sakana.ai/security-research-…

The Security Research Group is a R&D team studying collective, AI-driven cyber defense and the security and safety of AI itself.

As the use of AI leads to the discovery of more software flaws and an increase in security incidents, we are engaging in research and development aimed at fundamentally enhancing security, defining it as a quality issue and focusing on preventing the introduction of defects from the stages of design and development. Building quality into products is an area that has long been a key strength of Japan.

The group operates independently of our commercial business. We will share research, reproducible benchmarks, and practical guidelines openly, and work with government, industry, and academia.

Join us: sakana.ai/careers/member-of-… 🐟
